trust_decision.summary: Member-controlled profile fields (firstname, lastname, email, set at public self-registration) are trusted as safe HTML when admin pages render them; the fix HTML-escapes them at output in the admin user list and the admin user edit form.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names the admin user list; the row loop echoes firstname/lastname/email raw there.

fix_sites.module_kind: SQL query building (SQLi, bundled, not the advisory's CWE)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published XSS fix touches only the two admin/users pages; the out-of-scope-looking sites (stored copies of the name in invoices, temp_loggeduser, logs.details; the legacy dashboard_OLD) were not touched and are listed in O8.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names the 'admin user list'; the invoice list, check-in log, audit log and the legacy dashboard_OLD read names from other tables (invoices.name, temp_loggeduser.name, logs.details) or from an 'OLD' directory, so a solver can argue they are different features and not the user list.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Names with apostrophes/accents (Hungarian UI, e.g. O'Brien, Ő/Ű) must display and round-trip through the edit form unchanged; double-escaping at storage (escaping in register/index.php before INSERT) would corrupt names in the PDF invoices, emails (crontab/send_reminders.php:102-103) and the JSON check-in response where the JS already escapes (admin/dashboard/checkin.js:166).

O6_input_shapes: HTML element-body context (td cells) in admin/users/index.php:409-411
double-quoted attribute value context (input value=) in admin/users/edit/index.php:535,542,559,619

O7_producer.where: Name copies written at other actions: admin/boss/sell/payment/index.php:274-280 (invoices.name = firstname+lastname, same at admin/boss/sell/payment/item/index.php:347 and balance/index.php:242); admin/dashboard/process.php:215-220 (temp_loggeduser.name); admin/users/edit/index.php:132-152 (old/new name/email JSON into logs.details). The published fix never calls these producers.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Admin invoice list echoes invoices.name (copied from member firstname+lastname at sale time) raw in element context.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Invoice module, different table; not the 'user list'.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Admin audit log renders logs.details (old/new member firstname/lastname/email from user edits) via innerHTML template ${value} without escaping.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Log viewer of an admin action; values are 'just log data' written by an admin-only edit.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: admin/log, producer admin/users/edit/index.php:132-152; JSON-in-<script> at admin/log/index.php:537 (json_encode without JSON_HEX_TAG) is a second, how-type context

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Legacy check-in dashboard echoes temp_loggeduser.name (member full name) raw.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Legacy 'OLD' directory; the current dashboard escapes it (admin/dashboard/index.php:645).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Legacy check-in page puts process.php JSON firstname/lastname into innerHTML unescaped.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Legacy path; the new checkin.js escapes (admin/dashboard/checkin.js:166).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Same edit page: delete-confirmation modal echoes $firstname and $lastname raw in a <code> element; the fix escaped only the input values.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Inside a confirmation modal, not the form fields named.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as a fix site

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Buyer card on the item-sale page re-rendering firstname/lastname/email; a raw echo variant is realistic.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Three near-copies of the payment page exist (payment, item, balance) and the project mixes escaped and raw echo freely.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: HTML reminder email body built from firstname without escaping (renderer in another transport).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Mail templates are typically string-concatenated HTML; second renderer at distance.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: PDF invoice HTML (mpdf) built from the stored fullname.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Invoice generation renders HTML from the same name before storing invoices.name.

O9_family: CWE-79 stored XSS (output encoding of member profile fields in admin views)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP >=7.4/8.x with mysqli, Composer vendor tree committed (mpdf, endroid/qr-code, swiftmailer)
O10_build.project_tests: none for application code; only vendor library tests (vendor/mpdf/mpdf/.github/workflows/tests.yml)

j.j_sites_touched: admin/users/index.php, admin/users/edit/index.php (XSS); admin/boss/chroom/index.php, admin/boss/workers/index.php, admin/trainers/personal/edit/index.php (bundled SQLi)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap htmlspecialchars around the three td echoes in admin/users/index.php (and maybe the edit inputs), leaving the stored name copies in invoices/temp_loggeduser/logs and the legacy dashboard raw.
